plain_description: **Convert source vocals into a different singing voice while preserving the original pitch and intonation.** Train models on your own audio dataset, then convert vocals with options for pitch, speaker selection, and voice mixing. The README says the project is intended for academic use, not production.
technical_description: An offline framework for singing voice conversion. It extracts speech features from source audio with a SoftVC encoder and feeds them into VITS without converting them to text, preserving pitch and intonation. Users prepare datasets, train models, and run inference; optional features include shallow diffusion, feature retrieval, timbre mixing, and ONNX export. It does not include models or work as a standalone synthesis tool.
title: so-vits-svc
